title: 16 Fortune 500 companies are run by Indian-origin CEOs
sources: Indiaspora Impact Report (with Boston Consulting Group), 2024 - Small Community, Big Contributions, Boundless Horizons
American Kahani, 2024 - independent coverage of the Indiaspora/BCG report's Fortune 500 findings
caption:
Sixteen Fortune 500 companies are run by Indian-origin CEOs. Together, they generate more revenue than most countries' entire economies.

Per the most recent Fortune 500 analysis (Indiaspora/BCG, 2024), those sixteen companies generate $978 billion in combined revenue - about 5% of all Fortune 500 revenue, from just 3% of its CEOs. That's real overrepresentation: Indian-origin leaders control a bigger share of revenue than their share of CEO seats, spanning industries most people wouldn't guess - tech, healthcare, consumer goods, finance.

This isn't one company having a moment. It's a pattern, repeated across sixteen of America's largest companies at once.

Sources: Indiaspora Impact Report (with BCG), American Kahani
